Name: (AT) Spooncrows - Spy x Family
Author: Quody
Description:
Hi hello, I'm Spooner, and I've been making some Scarecrows. I tried my best to capture the style and personality of each character within the limitations that 16x32 pixels allows.

Updates will be pseudo-infrequent, and will be spurred by errors that you fine people catch, or things that catch my eye as I'm playing that I'm unhappy with. I may also add more characters, but these will take time, and will be even more random than the updates.


If you like this mod, consider one of my others;
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14080](AT) Spooncrows - Hunter x Hunter
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14081](AT) Spooncrows - Monster Prom﻿
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14121](AT) Spooncrows - Demon Slayer[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14239](AT) Spooncrows - Mob Psycho 100[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14328](AT) Spooncrows - To Your Eternity[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14420](AT) Spooncrows - JJBA: Stone Ocean[/url]


Thank you for listening to my short ramble, and I hope you enjoy yourself some Spooncrows.

-Spooner

Downloads.Description:
Added casual versions of the Forger family while adding some new characters.
Your current texture replacements from this mod may change, as when I rearrange the order they are listed, it can mess up existing sprite replacements.
